stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Dinamarca que otorga a Estados Unidos el "control permanente" de la seguridad de Groenlandia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark granting United States 'permanent control' of Greenland's security
en.summary: The U.S. president announced a security agreement with Denmark regarding Greenland, stating that no U.S. adversary will ever establish a military base there.

stories.title: Trump veta de la Casa Blanca a los medios CNN, MSNOW y Politico, a los que acusa de mentir

en.title: Trump bars CNN, MSNBC and Politico from White House, accusing them of lying
en.summary: The U.S. president restricted three news outlets from White House access, claiming they spread false information rather than legitimate reporting.

stories.title: La Casa Blanca veta a la CNN, MSNOW y Politico por difundir “noticias falsas”

en.title: White House bars CNN, MSNBC and Politico for spreading 'fake news'
en.summary: The president announced restrictions on three news organizations' White House access and indicated that other outlets accused of spreading false news would face similar measures.

stories.title: Trump anuncia el veto al acceso a la Casa Blanca de CNN, MSNBC y Politico

en.title: Trump announces ban on CNN, MSNBC and Politico from White House access
en.summary: The U.S. president escalated his criticism of news media by restricting three outlets from White House premises, a move expected to face legal challenges.

stories.title: El Trompas confiesa a las autoridades mexicanas que mató a la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte

en.title: El Trompas confesses to Mexican authorities that he killed Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte
en.summary: A Spanish student was killed during a robbery attempt, according to Mexican authorities who have ruled out a sexual motive for the assault. The suspect El Trompas has confessed to the crime.

stories.title: Unos 2.000 inmigrantes vuelven a las playas tras la saturación en el campamento del puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Around 2,000 immigrants return to beaches after overcrowding at Ceuta port camp
en.summary: Approximately 2,000 immigrants have returned to beaches in Ceuta following overcrowding at a port facility camp. The camp has capacity for 1,700 people but around 5,000 individuals are seeking entry, creating tension during the transfer operation.

stories.title: El detenido por el asesinato de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte en México confiesa el crimen: “Es lo que me toca”

en.title: Man arrested for murder of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico confesses to crime: "It's what I deserve"
en.summary: Police arrested a suspect in Cuautla in connection with the killing of a 21-year-old Spanish exchange student during a robbery. The victim's father is in Mexico to repatriate her body.

stories.title: Operación Puerto de Ceuta: el Gobierno habla de un 'efecto llamada' y se quedan más de 3.000 inmigrantes en la calle

en.title: Ceuta Port Operation: Government speaks of a 'pull factor' and over 3,000 immigrants remain on the street
en.summary: More than 3,000 migrants gathered at Ceuta beaches after descending from mountain locations, seeking placement in a new facility. The government attributed the increased arrivals to a pull factor effect.

stories.title: Ayuso se desentiende del expediente del ático: “No quiero saber nada de esa historia”

en.title: Ayuso distances herself from penthouse matter: "I don't want to know anything about that story"
en.summary: Madrid's regional president stated she was not responsible for managing the purchase of a luxury property she could use for occasional accommodation and visited when it was acquired.

stories.title: El Gobierno culpa al contencioso judicial del “efecto llamada” en el campamento del puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Government blames court proceedings for "pull factor" at Ceuta port camp
en.summary: The executive denounced the opposition leader's criticism of an operation to house over 1,700 immigrants at a port facility in Ceuta, describing his stance as reprehensible.

stories.title: Miles de migrantes vuelven a las playas de Trampolín y Benítez de Ceuta tras quedar fuera del campamento del Puerto

en.title: Thousands of migrants return to Trampolín and Benítez beaches in Ceuta after being excluded from port camp
en.summary: The Civil Guard began an operation early morning to manage crowds of migrants, requiring police reinforcement as people rushed toward the beaches after being excluded from the camp.

stories.title: Detenido 'El Trompas', el sospechoso del asesinato de la española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: El Trompas arrested as suspect in murder of Spanish woman Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Authorities arrested a suspect in connection with the death of Claudia Tacoronte, a Spanish woman killed with a blade weapon on September 12 in Cuautla, Mexico.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo por el que EEUU controlará la seguridad de Groenlandia

en.title: Trump announces agreement whereby US will control security of Greenland
en.summary: President Donald Trump stated he reached an agreement with Denmark to strengthen US military presence in Greenland, following months of threats to forcibly take the NATO-allied island.

stories.title: Cobega gana un 61% más y reparte 130 millones en dividendos

en.title: Cobega earnings jump 61% and distributes 130 million in dividends
en.summary: The beverages, coffee and restaurant group owned by the Daurella family achieved net profit of 411.5 million euros in 2025.

stories.title: Lagarde deja abierta su salida anticipada del BCE: "Ya veremos"

en.title: Lagarde leaves open early exit from ECB: "We'll see"
en.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde indicated uncertainty about whether she will remain in her position through the end of her current term.

stories.title: Telefónica, víctima del correctivo bursátil a las telecos

en.title: Telefónica victim of stock market correction in telecoms
en.summary: Telecommunications companies became Europe's worst-performing sector, with Telefónica's share price declining along with other telecom stocks across the continent.

stories.title: El golpe de On a Nike: ficha a Mbappé y prepara sus primeras botas de fútbol

en.title: On's blow to Nike: signs Mbappé and prepares its first football boots
en.summary: Swiss company On ended Mbappé's two-decade association with Nike by signing him as global ambassador and shareholder. On plans to launch football boots in 2027 with Thierry Henry as division director.
